children: FRASERS- ENTERED INTO DISCUSSIONS WITH MR STEPHAN STURM, CHAIRMAN OF SUPERVISORY BOARD OF HUGO BOSS, REGARDING COMPOSITION OF, AND AN INCREASE IN, FRASERS' REPRESENTATION ON, SUPERVISORY BOARD OF HUGO BOSS

FRASERS- FRASERS AND MR STURM HAVE THEREFORE MUTUALLY AGREED THAT MR STURM WILL STEP DOWN FROM HIS POSITION AS CHAIRMAN AND MEMBER OF SUPERVISORY BOARD AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AS PERMITTED BY HUGO BOSS' CONSTITUTION
FRASERS- IN ADDITION, FRASERS WILL ALSO SEEK APPOINTMENT OF ROBERT PALMER AS A FURTHER MEMBER OF SUPERVISORY BOARD.

title: Frasers says to seek appointment of Robert Palmer as member of supervisory board of Hugo Boss.
